question:
What is the median of the following distribution?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/732d69437c0dd90b2d9592fdbc81edd9319eceb2bf3091df292e237d394caeae.png]
solution:
**Formula used:**

 {Median} = L + dfrac{(N)/(2) - CF}{f} times h 

Where:

L = lower boundary of median class

N = total frequency

CF = cumulative frequency before median class

f = frequency of median class

h = class width
